options.name: init_config
options.description: All options defined here are available to all instances.

options.name: service
options.description:
Attach the tag `service:<SERVICE>` to every metric, event, and service check emitted by this integration.

Additionally, this sets the default `service` for every log source.

options.name: instances
options.description: Every instance is scheduled independently of the others.

options.name: name
options.description: An arbitrary name to identify the supervisord server.

options.name: host
options.description: The host where the supervisord server is running.

options.name: port
options.description:
The TCP port value that supervisor is listening on for HTTP/XML-RPC requests.

See: http://supervisord.org/configuration.html#inet-http-server-section-settings

options.name: socket
options.description:
The path to a UNIX domain socket that supervisor is listening on for HTTP/XML-RPC requests.

See: http://supervisord.org/configuration.html#unix-http-server-section-settings

options.name: username
options.description: Required only if a username is configured.

options.name: password
options.description: Required only if a password is configured.

options.name: proc_regex
options.description: Regex pattern[s] matching the names of processes to monitor.

options.name: proc_names
options.description:
The process to monitor within this supervisord instance.
If not specified, the check will monitor all processes.

options.name: proc_regex_exclude
options.description: Regular expression pattern[s] for names of processes to exclude.

options.name: proc_names_exclude
options.description: The process not to monitor within this supervisord instance.

options.name: status_mapping_override
options.description:
The process status mapping override between supervisord status and Datadog status.

This setting overrides default mapping (supervisord => Datadog):
  RUNNING  => up
  BACKOFF  => down
  STOPPING => down
  STOPPED  => down
  EXITED   => down
  FATAL    => down
  STARTING => unknown
  UNKNOWN  => unknown

Available Datadog status are: up / down / unknown

options.name: tags
options.description:
A list of tags to attach to every metric and service check emitted by this instance.

Learn more about tagging at https://docs.datadoghq.com/tagging

options.name: service
options.description:
Attach the tag `service:<SERVICE>` to every metric, event, and service check emitted by this integration.

Overrides any `service` defined in the `init_config` section.

options.name: min_collection_interval
options.description:
This changes the collection interval of the check. For more information, see:
https://docs.datadoghq.com/developers/write_agent_check/#collection-interval

options.name: empty_default_hostname
options.description:
This forces the check to send metrics with no hostname.

This is useful for cluster-level checks.

options.name: metric_patterns
options.description:
A mapping of metrics to include or exclude, with each entry being a regular expression.

Metrics defined in `exclude` will take precedence in case of overlap.

options.name: logs
options.description:
Log Section

type - required - Type of log input source (tcp / udp / file / windows_event).
port / path / channel_path - required - Set port if type is tcp or udp.
                                        Set path if type is file.
                                        Set channel_path if type is windows_event.
source  - required - Attribute that defines which integration sent the logs.
encoding - optional - For file specifies the file encoding. Default is utf-8. Other
                      possible values are utf-16-le and utf-16-be.
service - optional - The name of the service that generates the log.
                     Overrides any `service` defined in the `init_config` section.
tags - optional - Add tags to the collected logs.

Discover Datadog log collection: https://docs.datadoghq.com/logs/log_collection/
